bio.text: Wes Moore has been Governor of Maryland since January 2023 and is the Democratic candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

He was born in Takoma Park, Maryland, and earned an associate degree from Valley Forge Military College in 1998, a bachelor's degree from Johns Hopkins University, and a master's degree from the University of Oxford as a Rhodes Scholar.
He was commissioned as a U.S. Army second lieutenant, deployed to Afghanistan in 2005 with the 82nd Airborne Division, and later served as a White House Fellow.
Before becoming governor he founded the education company BridgeEdU, wrote books including The Other Wes Moore, and served as CEO of the Robin Hood Foundation.
